definitions: To bring and hand over (a letter, parcel, or ordered goods) to the proper recipient or address.
To help in the birth of (a baby).
To present or utter (a speech, lecture, or sermon).
To aim and throw or strike (a blow or punch).
examples: The company failed to deliver on its promises.
She delivered a healthy baby boy.
The boxer delivered a knockout punch.
God will deliver us from evil.
